headline: Anthropic Shares Rise 17% in Stock Market Debut
summary: Anthropic shares closed up 17% in their first day of trading following the artificial intelligence company's initial public offering. Retail investors participated, though the debut failed to provide a broad lift to the technology sector.
why: Anthropic is one of the leading generative artificial intelligence developers. Its public market performance is closely tracked as an indicator of investor sentiment toward AI hardware and software investments.
